source: Own measurement, 2026-11-24, on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: 12 episodes, one per unit, draw 4 of tests/hidden/episode_selection.json; draws 1 to 3 are void, draw 3 because the cameras' renderer and the model's contact shapes changed frozen files) with this build's grader: the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505), ale validate run validate-5e728233 on a shared x86-64 Linux host (AMD Zen 5, Docker, load about 25): mean_episode_credit 1.0 (the oracle's verification.json), 12 of 12 episodes scored, no simulation faults, the numerics check and the render self-test passed, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 195 of 195 differing; the controller's own time 31 s of the 9000 s budget; the verify stage took 735 s for the 12 episodes. At the selection every kept episode gave credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire (1616-2264 steps).
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json: 26 candidates tried, 21 kept, the first kept per unit). full_at 0.98: the runs showed no spread; one hinge's pin missing in one episode costs 0.75 of that episode (its 0.25 and the 0.5 of the swing test, which needs both hinges): 0.0625 of the metric, a reward of 0.96.
